I'd also not passed the certification exam
But I retook the exam in January (and passed!!) and as of today, I have my first official client that I'll be working with twice a week!!"

I'm thrilled to hear that you not only passed the certification exam in January but also secured your first official client. This is a testament to your hard work and dedication. Remember, it's not about how you start, but how you finish, and you've shown that you have what it takes to excel in your field. 

Keep up the fantastic work, and always remember to believe in yourself and your abilities. I'm confident that you'll continue to grow and achieve great things in your career. Wishing you all the best in your journey ahead!

method.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘完整性与深度’维度时，设立‘关键情感锚点覆盖’否决项：1. 提取输入中关于‘危机’、‘风险’或‘极度困难’的描述作为核心情感锚点；2. 审查回答是否对这些锚点给予了直接的承认、共情或化解（如使用‘克服了...’、‘面对...依然...’等表述）；3. 若回答完全遗漏了对核心情感锚点的回应，仅庆祝最终结果，即使其他细节（如日期、具体动作）被提及，也应判定为低分，因为这表明模型未理解用户分享故事的核心动机是寻求对挣扎过程的认可；4. 此核验旨在防止模型产出‘报喜不报忧’式的浅层回复，确保回应具有情感厚度。
